verdict.rationale: Jules has a first-party API at developers.google.com/jules/api. It covers API key creation, sessions, sending messages to the agent, approving plans and an optional automationMode for PR creation. A community user independently built an MCP server on top of it to dispatch tasks. The OpenAPI probes returned 404, but they checked jules.google rather than the developer docs host, so they don't contradict the API's existence. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and fuller endpoint reference detail beyond the excerpted snippets.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
